data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Context
Story 2f51 verifier P1=FAIL on the atomic-deletion static-scan DD. The
5 bridge files are correctly deleted from the worktree, but the
verification script targets the WRONG directory under normal session
environment:

  _PLUGIN_GIT_PATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT#"$REPO_ROOT"/}"

When CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT points at the main repo's plugin cache
(/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/plugins/dso) and REPO_ROOT
resolves to the worktree (/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/<id>),
the prefix strip finds no common prefix and leaves _PLUGIN_GIT_PATH as
the absolute path into the MAIN repo. The reconciler zone then scans
the main repo's reconciler/ — which still contains bootstrap.py and
the 4 _band.py modules — producing 6 hits and strict-mode exit 1.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh derives the
      reconciler zone path from __file__ unconditionally (or strips
      REPO_ROOT from __file__) so it always targets the running
      worktree, not CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT's external location
- [ ] Strict-mode scan exits 0 in BOTH cases:
      (a) CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset
      (b) CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT set to /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/plugins/dso
- [ ] tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh updated
      to assert strict-mode 0-exit under both environment configurations
- [ ] Shellcheck clean

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh — Edit
- tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Fix check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh _PLUGIN_GIT_PATH derivation for worktree sessions (2f51 DD remediation)
